'''August 2000 Cedar Grove tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cedar Grove, NJ on 12 August 2000. [[Michael Dalton]] won it. It is known from Kim Caton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1121">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-cedar-grove-nj-8-12-00d1121/ cedar-grove-nj-8-12-00], DeckTech (Kimberly "Arwen Even*" Caton, 14 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-cedar-grove-nj-8-12-00d1121/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 29
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Dalton]]
